charts.title: HD 95338 b: orbits around HD 95338
charts.description: The orbits of HD 95338's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 95338 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kálmán et al. 2025 (2025A&A...701A.240K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname K_AMP_AACUTE_LM_AMP_AACUTE_N_ET_AL__2025): P 55.082694 d

charts.title: HD 95338 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 95338 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (64, 90, 99) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 304142124, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 22-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 22-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
